aboutIntro.from:
WICK'D es mucho más que una colección de productos. Es un universo de diseños atrevidos, variedades distintivas y presentaciones únicas.

Desde los Indoor Exotic Pre-Rolls y las colecciones Diamond Infused hasta los Hashholes y Blue Lotus, cada parte del catálogo WICK'D aporta su propia personalidad a la experiencia.
aboutIntro.to:
WICK'D is more than a collection of products. It's a world of bold visuals, distinctive varieties, and unique presentations.

From Indoor Exotic Pre-Rolls and Diamond Infused collections to Hashholes and Blue Lotus, every part of the WICK'D lineup brings its own character to the experience.

aboutBody.from:
Desde los icónicos Northern Lights y Granddaddy Purple hasta nombres inspirados en frutas como Pineapple Punch y Lemon Cherry, WICK'D reúne una selección diversa que destaca por su variedad e individualidad.

Descubre desde frascos con múltiples unidades y prácticos empaques dúo y trío hasta Hashhole Tubes empaquetados individualmente. Diferentes formatos, empaques distintivos y una colección con el sello inconfundible de WICK'D.
aboutBody.to:
From the iconic Northern Lights and Granddaddy Purple to fruit-inspired names like Pineapple Punch and Lemon Cherry, WICK'D brings together a diverse lineup designed around variety and individuality.

Discover everything from multi-count jars and convenient duo and trio pouches to individually packaged Hashhole Tubes. Different formats, distinctive packaging, and a lineup that's unmistakably WICK'D.

aboutSectionSubtitle.to: More Than Packaging. A Visual Statement.

aboutSectionBody.from:
WICK'D is built around a bold visual identity that connects the entire brand. Expressive artwork, distinctive color palettes, and recognizable packaging bring that identity to life across the lineup.

Every collection adds its own character while staying part of the same WICK'D world. It's an approach that celebrates variety, individuality, and a look you can recognize at a glance.
aboutSectionBody.to:
At WICK'D, every detail plays a part in the bigger picture. Expressive artwork, striking colors, and distinctive packaging give each collection a personality of its own.

From the first glance to the smallest design detail, the WICK'D aesthetic is made to stand out. Different styles, different collections, all connected by one unmistakable visual identity.

aboutSectionCaption.to: A glimpse of WICK'D's visual identity.
